name: my-coding-agent
description: Coding agent with a desktop UI

scripts.check: tsc -p packages/ai/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/agent/tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/web/tsconfig.json && node scripts/check-tokens.ts packages/web/src/tokens.css packages/web/src/style.css
scripts.desktop: npm run build:web && npm run start --workspace=@my-agent/desktop
scripts.desktop:dev: npm run build:web && npm run dev --workspace=@my-agent/desktop
scripts.desktop:screenshot: npm run build:web && npm run screenshot --workspace=@my-agent/desktop
